verdict.description: pass = no actionable problem found; findings = the findings array is non-empty

summary.description: One short paragraph: what was reviewed and the overall risk read

claim.description: The specific defect claimed, one sentence

evidence.description: What in the diff/snapshot supports the claim — quote or cite the exact code

failure_path.description: The concrete execution path to the failure; a finding with no execution path is speculation

finding_line.description: Outcome-ledger instrumentation line, only when the prompt supplies a tag taxonomy

rule_line.description: Auto-capture instrumentation line for a RECURRING finding class, only when the prompt supplies a tag taxonomy
